items.exampleEn: My father joined a photography association.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸加入了一個攝影協會。

items.exampleEn: It is illegal to take these birds home.
items.exampleZh: 把這些鳥帶回家是違法的。

items.exampleEn: Do you have any special requests for dinner?
items.exampleZh: 晚餐你有什麼特別的要求嗎？

items.exampleEn: The police are looking for a violent man.
items.exampleZh: 警察正在找一名行為暴力的男子。

items.exampleEn: Cats are famous for their independence.
The police officers here are not armed.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的警察沒有配帶武器。

items.exampleEn: At the end of the story, the police catch the killer.
items.exampleZh: 故事最後，警察抓到了兇手。

items.exampleEn: He works so hard, like a slave.
items.exampleZh: 他工作辛苦得像個奴隸一樣。

items.sentenceEn: The bank has armed guards at the door.

items.audioEn: The association meets on the first Monday of every month.
items.audioZh: 協會每個月第一個星期一開會。
options: Every Friday afternoon at the office

items.sentenceEn: The parents' association helps our school a lot.
items.sentenceZh: 家長會幫了我們學校很多忙。

items.sentenceEn: Don't be a slave to your phone.

items.stemEn: The hotel said yes to our ____ for a quiet room.
items.stemZh: 飯店答應了我們要安靜房間的要求。

items.stemEn: I don't let my children watch ____ movies with a lot of blood.
items.stemZh: 我不讓孩子看有很多血腥畫面的暴力電影。

items.passageEn: Last week, our town's sports association had a meeting. Many young people came with one request: they wanted a skate park. Right now, skating in the town center is illegal, so they have no place to go. One girl said, "We want some independence and a safe place to have fun." In the end, the association said yes. The new park will open next spring.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們鎮上的體育協會開了一次會。很多年輕人帶著一個請求來參加：他們想要一座滑板公園。目前在鎮中心溜滑板是違法的，所以他們沒地方可去。一個女孩說：「我們想要一點自主，還有一個能安全玩樂的地方。」最後協會答應了。新公園明年春天就會開放。

referenceEn: Who is the killer in this novel?
Who is the killer in this book?
rubricZh: 問句可寫例如 Who is…?

items.promptZh: 有了自己的車，我更獨立自主了。
referenceEn: Having my own car gives me more independence.
My own car gives me more independence.
rubricZh: 用 independence 表示「獨立自主」（例如 more independence）
「有了自己的車」可寫，例如 Having my own car、My own car 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 gives、gave 等）
